levels.surface: جعفر بن محمد بن إبراهيم الموسوي
جعفر بن محمد بن حكيم الخثعمي

notes: Three routes carry the same saying («مثله»); each ends at Abu al-Hasan, an Imam after «عن» (narrator)
In the first route «عن أبي الحسن (ع) قَالَ سَأَلْتُهُ» has an unnamed first-person asker, so the speaker is not named in the text (rule 11)
«جميعاً» joins Ibn Abi Umayr and Ibrahim b. Abd al-Hamid at one level; «أبي ره» is a bare relation
